args.cypher: MATCH (n:BodhiInstance) WHERE n.slug STARTS WITH 'bmm/operativebusinessrule/' RETURN n.name AS name, n.enforcementLevel AS level, n.ruleScope AS scope, n.ruleImplementation AS how, n.ruleReference AS ref, n.knowledgeNeed AS need, n.definition AS def, left(n.wiki_content, 700) AS body ORDER BY name
